description: In a restriction-closed function tree, each node has height equal to its domain ordinal.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.functionTree_nodeHeight.{u} {θ : Ordinal.{u}} {X : Type u}
  (S : Set (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.FunctionNode θ X))
  (hS : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.RestrictionClosed S)
  (t : (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.functionTree S hS).carrier) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.nodeHeight (Lemmatheca.SetTheory.InfiniteTrees.functionTree S hS) t =
    ↑(↑t).fst.toOrd
